names.en: Eastern Sea information path true inheritance
names.ru: Истинное наследие пути информации Восточного моря

summary.text: Eastern Sea information path true inheritance is an information path legacy whose key is an insignia on flying sword Immortal Gu. Deduction places it in Eastern Sea rather than Northern Plains.

claims.text: Chu Du first guesses that the insignia on flying sword Immortal Gu opens the sword path true inheritance of Sword Immortal Bo Qing.

Tian Xia Xin says the carving was added to flying sword Immortal Gu after the Gu already existed. The method is unheard of: information path dao marks rest on a rank seven sword path Immortal Gu, a fragment of sword path dao marks, and remain for a long time instead of being destroyed by path conflict. He rates the true inheritance as high quality enough that even he, who inherited an extraordinary wisdom path inheritance, is interested.

Fang Yuan does not want to seek the information path true inheritance from the flying sword Immortal Gu clues yet. He treats the turbulent flow sea area as a problematic place, easy to get lost in, and often traveled by Gu Immortals, and he puts his attention on Hei Fan’s true inheritance instead.

When Chu Du renegotiates, Fang Yuan has to concede value that includes flying sword Immortal Gu, the Eastern Sea information path true inheritance, the thirteenth eagle nest, and Hei Fan’s true inheritance together. Chu Du is a strength path cultivator and does not mean to cultivate information path on the side, but he can still sell those gains.

Ying Wu Xie tells Hei Lou Lan that heaven’s will once planned to lure Fang Yuan with this information path true inheritance, and that the arrangements inside the turbulent flow sea area were wasted when Fang Yuan went to Northern Plains without stopping. The narration adds that Fang Yuan had not sensed the clues then, because they were concealed in flying sword Immortal Gu.

The information path Gu Immortal who left it had barely survived a battle, entered a bubble, and set up the inheritance there. It is an information path inheritance, but most of the information is already lost. Fang Yuan still saves an Immortal Gu named Perceivable Dao, an information path investigative Immortal Gu that shows what types of dao marks a target has and in what quantity. A skeleton on the site is not the creator. It is an enemy the information path Gu Immortal killed, with that enemy’s dao marks left inside the bones, which the creator’s thoughts say can be used as immortal material.

Fang Yuan judges that the complete true inheritance may have held methods against dao marks, which matches both the insignia on flying sword Immortal Gu and the carved skeleton. He obtained the true inheritance too late: most of the Gu worms are dead, and the information path methods are lost. The Eastern Sea information path inheritance had sat for too long. The information path Gu Immortal had just killed his enemy and created the inheritance on the verge of death, so the contents could not last.
